title: Cross-Dataset Known Issues Advisory
purpose: Systematic issues discovered during JSSODa audit that affect multiple datasets. Integration scripts MUST check this advisory and apply relevant mitigations.

issues.title: Docling layout label casing mismatch
issues.scope: All 51 datasets using Docling layout extraction
issues.symptom: layout_detections[*].class_name uses lowercase/snake_case (text, list_item, section_header) instead of DocLayNet PascalCase (Text, List-Item, Section-Header)
issues.root_cause: Docling layout extractor outputs its own label format; schema expects DocLayNet 11-class taxonomy with PascalCase and hyphens
issues.fix: Run scripts/standardize_layout_labels.py --dataset <name>. Script now converts class_name to PascalCase, adds canonical_class, source_schema, source_label, is_lossy, conversion_confidence.
issues.integration_action: Run standardize_layout_labels.py BEFORE integration script. Integration scripts should verify class_name uses PascalCase.

issues.title: Docling Table detection unreliable on multi-column text
issues.scope: Synthetic datasets with multi-column text layouts; potentially scanned multi-column documents
issues.symptom: Docling layout extractor classifies multi-column text blocks as 'Table' class, producing false positive has_table content flags
issues.root_cause: Docling's ML-based layout detection cannot distinguish columnar text layout from tabular data. The regular column structure of multi-column text triggers the Table classifier.

evidence.vlm_verification: All 10 flagged samples visually inspected - none contain actual tables

issues.fix: VLM visual inspection of all has_table=True samples. Override to False where multi-column text is the cause.
issues.integration_action: Do NOT trust Docling Table detections for content flags. Require VLM verification for has_table=True on synthetic/multi-column datasets.
affected_datasets_likely: Any synthetic dataset with multi-column layouts

issues.title: Docling Picture detection unreliable on dense text
issues.scope: Synthetic datasets with dense text blocks or dark rendering
issues.symptom: Docling layout extractor classifies dense text blocks or dark rendering artifacts as 'Picture' class, producing false positive has_figure content flags
issues.root_cause: Dense text regions or unusual rendering (dark backgrounds, vertical text blocks) trigger the Picture classifier in Docling's layout model.

evidence.vlm_verification: All 3 flagged samples visually inspected - none contain actual figures/pictures

issues.fix: VLM visual inspection of has_figure=True samples on synthetic datasets.
issues.integration_action: Verify has_figure=True on synthetic datasets via VLM. Lower confidence for figure detection on text-heavy synthetic documents.

issues.title: LLM handwriting detection unreliable on synthetic images
issues.scope: All synthetic datasets processed with LLM vision enrichment
issues.symptom: LLM flags synthetic (typed/rendered) text as containing handwriting. In one case, the word 'handwriting' appearing in text content confused the LLM.
issues.root_cause: LLM vision cannot reliably distinguish between typed/rendered text and handwriting on synthetic images. Semantic confusion: text content discussing handwriting triggers false positives.

evidence.semantic_confusion_example: jssoda_horizontal_00934.png - text mentions 手書き (handwriting) but contains no actual handwritten text
evidence.vlm_verification: All 4 flagged samples visually inspected - all typed/rendered text

issues.fix: For known synthetic datasets: override has_handwriting=False globally. For mixed datasets: VLM verification required.
issues.fix_status: PATTERN - apply override in integration scripts for synthetic datasets
issues.integration_action: For capture_method=synthetic datasets: set has_handwriting=False, handwriting_present=False with confidence 1.0 (source: dataset_documentation). Do NOT rely on LLM detection.

issues.title: LLM cannot detect synthetic capture method
issues.scope: All synthetic datasets processed with LLM vision enrichment
issues.symptom: LLM classifies synthetic images as born_digital or scanner_flatbed instead of synthetic
issues.root_cause: LLM vision has no reliable way to distinguish clean synthetic renders from high-quality born-digital documents. Both appear as crisp, artifact-free rendered text.
issues.fix: Override capture_method from dataset documentation for known synthetic datasets.
issues.fix_status: PATTERN - apply override in integration scripts
issues.integration_action: For known synthetic datasets: hardcode capture_method='synthetic' with confidence 1.0 (source: dataset_documentation). Known synthetic datasets: jssoda, synth-multiscript-250k, docsynth300k.

issues.title: LLM formula detection over-flags scientific discussion text
issues.scope: All datasets with LLM vision enrichment
issues.symptom: LLM flags text discussing chemistry, mathematics, or science as has_formula=True even when no rendered mathematical expressions are present
issues.root_cause: LLM detects semantic discussion of formulas/equations in text content rather than visual presence of rendered mathematical notation.

false_positive_examples: Chemistry text mentioning pH (no rendered formula)

issues.fix: VLM visual inspection of has_formula=True samples to distinguish rendered math from text discussing math.
issues.integration_action: Treat LLM has_formula as candidate only. Require VLM verification for datasets where formula accuracy matters.

issues.title: LLM domain classification produces high UNK rate on generic content
issues.scope: All datasets with generic/narrative/creative text content
issues.symptom: LLM classifies generic text (personal narratives, cultural essays, creative writing) as domain_level1=UNK
issues.root_cause: Domain classification taxonomy (ADM, EDU, SCI, FIN, etc.) doesn't cover generic/literary/narrative content well. LLM correctly identifies these as not fitting any specific domain.

evidence.assessment: UNK is correct classification - these are genuinely generic content that doesn't fit clean domain categories

issues.fix: Accept UNK as valid classification. Consider adding a 'GEN' (general) or 'LIT' (literary) domain category.
issues.fix_status: ACCEPTED - not a defect, taxonomy limitation
issues.integration_action: Accept domain_level1=UNK on prescreening. Do not force reclassification.

issues.title: script_family contains directionality instead of family name
issues.scope: All datasets processed by base metadata annotator
issues.symptom: script_family field contains 'ltr' or 'rtl' (directionality values) instead of valid family names ('latin', 'cjk', 'arabic', etc.)
issues.root_cause: Base metadata annotator script populates script_family with text directionality instead of calling get_script_family(iso15924_script) from iso_language_script module.
issues.fix: In integration scripts: derive script_family via get_script_family(iso15924_script) from image_preprocessing_detector.schema_utils.iso_language_script.
issues.fix_status: PATTERN - apply in integration scripts. Fix base annotator to prevent recurrence.
issues.integration_action: Always re-derive script_family from iso15924_script via get_script_family(). Do not trust base metadata value.

issues.title: Dataset documentation language/script claims unreliable
issues.scope: All datasets where language/script was set from documentation claims without cross-validation
issues.symptom: iso639_language and iso15924_script in base metadata may be wrong when derived solely from dataset documentation or paper claims
issues.root_cause: Dataset authors may provide inaccurate language descriptions. RealDAE paper describes 'English documents' but 74% of content is Chinese. Parser trusts documentation without cross-validation.
issues.fix: Cross-validate documentation language claims with LLM enrichment before trusting as ground truth. For monolingual claims, verify via LLM on representative sample.
issues.integration_action: NEVER use documentation-only language. Always prioritize LLM enrichment for iso639_language and iso15924_script when LLM enrichment is available.
affected_datasets_likely: Any dataset with documentation-sourced language annotations

mitigation_checklist.description: Checklist for new dataset integration scripts to avoid known issues
pre_integration: Run standardize_layout_labels.py --dataset <name> to fix label casing (KI-001)
Determine capture_method from dataset documentation, not LLM (KI-005)
For synthetic datasets: plan has_handwriting=False override (KI-004)
Cross-validate documentation language claims with LLM enrichment (KI-009)
Always re-derive script_family from iso15924_script via get_script_family() (KI-008)
during_integration: Use derive_content_flags() from standardized layout as baseline
For synthetic datasets: override has_table, has_figure, has_handwriting from VLM or documentation (KI-002, KI-003, KI-004)
Use get_script_family() for script_family, never trust base metadata 'ltr'/'rtl' (KI-008)
Prioritize LLM enrichment for iso639_language and iso15924_script over documentation claims (KI-009)
post_integration: Run prescreening to verify field population
VLM-inspect 10-15 stratified passing samples for accuracy validation
